headline: Edison International (EIX) Stock Still Looks Cheap With Wildfire Risks In View
summary: Edison International stock has delivered a strong 68.8% total return over the past five years, yet the latest valuation checks still suggest the shares lean cheap rather than stretched at the current US$73.37 price. The 68.8% five year return shows that long term holders have already seen solid gains, so any further upside now needs to be supported by fundamentals rather than momentum alone.
